title: Update ESLint to 10.7.0
summary: Update the root WebView lint dependency from ESLint 9 to the current ESLint 10.7.0 release through npm resolution.
reason: A direct compatibility run proved ESLint 10 against the complete WebView prework suite. Dependabot PR #35's red jobs were stale generated package-summary evidence and an unrelated browser navigation timeout, not lint incompatibility.
behavior_before: The root lockfile selected ESLint 9.39.4 and allowed the 9.x range.
behavior_after: The root lockfile selects ESLint 10.7.0 and requires Node 20.19+, 22.13+, or 24+, which is compatible with repository Node 22 CI and the current local Node 24 runtime.
manual_validation: PASS: npm install resolved ESLint 10.7.0 and npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities.
PASS: complete npm run webview:prework:check with ESLint 10.7.0.
PASS: WebView lint budget reported 1,397 warnings against the unchanged 1,402 ceiling and zero errors.
PASS: all generated WebView map, contract, DOM, route, command-boundary, and script-order checks.
rollback_plan: Use npm to restore the ESLint 9 range and lock graph, then rerun npm audit and the complete WebView prework suite.
notes: npm performed all package-lock changes. No generated report, warning budget, lint rule, ignore, test, or release gate was weakened. The current @eslint/js 9 flat configuration remains compatible with ESLint 10 and passed unchanged.
